name: aquarius
description: Aquarius — a WYSIWYG math note editor. LaTeX is the output format, not the input format.

scripts.prepare-mathlive: rm -rf public/mathlive/fonts && mkdir -p public/mathlive && cp -r node_modules/mathlive/fonts public/mathlive/
scripts.dev: npm run prepare-mathlive && npm run prepare-pyodide && npm run prepare-pdfjs && next dev
scripts.build: npm run prepare-mathlive && npm run prepare-pyodide && npm run prepare-pdfjs && next build
scripts.build:static: npm run prepare-mathlive && npm run prepare-pyodide && npm run prepare-pdfjs && node scripts/build-static.mjs
scripts.ios:sync:static: npm run build:static && CAP_STATIC=1 cap sync ios
